meta.passNote: Expanded multi-source set: 42 dive / 42 fish pins. Redondo A restored to official CDFG 118d24m34s. Mission Bay wreckalley lon corrected to official 117d16m. Star of Scotland CDN vs USC disagree ~0.36 NM - not added. Bolsa Chica BD lon disagrees with CDFG - not added.
meta.policy: Display only pins with named-site GPS confirmed by >=2 independent internet sources agreeing within ~0.2 NM (~370 m). No manual seaward nudges. Prefer official CDFW/CDFG Appendix + USC Sea Grant LA Fishing Guide; for SD/OC reefs without USC coverage use CDFG Appendix + independently published waypoint tables (e.g. Bloodydecks 2006) when they agree within threshold.
